avis.titre: Make it part of your routine!
avis.texte: I love these! My face is usually very clean before using them and there is so much liquid in the container that you can sometimes use a pad twice. They aren't very thick but they work very well. I usually just have to fan my face dry. It is not scented. It feels good on the face. You can feel your pores open.

avis.texte: Does not peel the dead skin or dark spots or sting as it’s suppose to. It’s okay.

Only used the pads twice but really like them. They have good ingredients and I know they will improve my facial skin . I like the tweezers to remove each pad one at a time. I will be using them before bed.
Good product! Love the individual pads. I use this every morning and my face glows and so soft and clear. Very easy to use and the serum is excellent on price point
Very gentle but extremely effective. Not an instant result but after a few weeks my skin is brighter and softer
I don’t think there is 20% glycolic acid in this. This felt far milder than the plain 7% glycolic acid I had been using. It did not have much of an effect in any way.
Keeps a glow on my face. No skin irritation. I use less moisturizer.
Awesome product! The acid pads work great. I highly recommend them and will purchase them again.

Being that I never used glycolic acid pads before I wasn’t sure what to expect in terms of results. But I’m happy I gave these a try. Ive only been using them for a few weeks and so far I can say that my skin looks more refreshed, brighter, and less dull. Ive also noticed a difference in the size of my pores, which can sometimes be very noticeable. I didn’t have any irritation or stinging using these and I didn’t notice any fragrances. These pads are thin and very moist. Because of that I did have a hard time grabbing just one, even when using the included tongs.

avis.titre: Strong but doesn’t Dry skin out
avis.texte: It feels like it actually gets intense in my in my face, still clean a little on the dry side, but not too dry doesn’t irritate my skin, but I would definitely moisturize after use. It definitely takes the oil the dirt off my skin pores feel cleaner my skin looks a little bit more brighter. I like that form instead of a liquid have to put it on a cotton bowl or pad. It makes it more convenient for me.

These saturated pads are a powerful blend of glycolic acid, salicylic acid, tea tree oil, niacinamide, centella asiatica, and vitamin C. This combination offers excellent exfoliation and toning benefits. Glycolic and salicylic acids promote skin cell turnover and deeply cleanse pores, helping to refine skin texture. They're particularly effective for oily and acne-prone skin. Tea tree oil provides antimicrobial properties, while vitamin C and niacinamide work together to brighten the complexion. These are all powerhouse ingredients in skincare. I recommend following up with a good moisturizer and sunscreen, especially if you're using these in your morning routine. Personally, I use these pads in the morning because I reserve stronger actives for nighttime. They help control oil production and have kept my skin clearer and more breakout-free. I've also noticed a brighter, more radiant complexion since using them, as well as an improvement in skin texture. I'm well-conditioned to these ingredients, so I haven't experienced any irritation. However, if you're new to acids or active ingredients, I suggest starting slowly and making sure to moisturize well to minimize any potential dryness or sensitivity.

avis.titre: Best for beginners or people with oil/acne problems
avis.texte: These glycolic acid pads are just OK. I don’t really think they are a strength of 20%. I use and I’ve tried quite a lot of chemical exfoliants and of course glycolic acid is a popular one that can work very well if you get one that’s good quality. The one that I typically use is strong and pretty fantastic, and by comparison this one is a bit weak, although not entirely unuseful. This is something that I might carry with me while traveling or on the go, etc. if I need something quick and easy because my typical process is more complicated than just pulling out a single wipe and swiping it across my face. So this is useful if you still want to stay in line with your usual routine, but do need more ease. The pads themselves are alright but are a little on the thin side so can be hard to hold. I do prefer something more substantial. And the scent of this isn’t something that bothers me. I’m sure for someone that has sensitive skin this might be a good product for you to use regularly like three times a week or so if your skin can’t stand a stronger product. But honestly I don’t really see a huge difference in my skin using this product. It does have salicylic acid in it too which will be great for people that have more problems with oil and acne. So I would recommend it for them. This product may be worth a try, depending on your skin type, sensitivity, and needs. I do hope this review is helpful and you have a fantastic day!

I’ve been using these glycolic acid pads for a few weeks, and they’ve quickly become a staple in my skincare routine. The dual-sided design is great, one side has a textured surface that gives a gentle exfoliation, while the smooth side is perfect for wiping across more sensitive areas. I’ve noticed my skin looking brighter, smoother, and more even-toned, and the fine lines around my forehead are already less noticeable. I really like that these pads also contain salicylic acid to help with breakouts and niacinamide for calming and hydration. They give me that “just had a facial” glow without the expense of a spa visit. The 20% glycolic acid is strong, so I recommend starting slowly if you’ve never used acids before, but my skin tolerated it well when paired with a good moisturizer. These are a fantastic option for anyone looking to improve skin texture, reduce dullness, or fight early signs of aging. Definitely worth it!

I get the impression that products like this ultimately depend on consistent usage over time, which is... not my strong suit. So while I can't yet verify the efficacy, I'm not going to ding the product for my own faults. I can confirm that the pads are soaked with a generous amount of product, and that they're a decent size (though mine were a little more oblong than round, as you can see in the photo). I do feel a little sensation after using a pad, so there's likely SOMETHING going on. The included tweezers for grabbing the pads is theoretically a nice touch, but they're too big to fit in the jar (at least not when it's full of pads), so there's no way I'd be able to keep track of them.

avis.titre: Put these on your holy grail list because you won't be disappointed!
avis.texte: I'm a huge fan of a luxury brand that has facial peel pads in a small package for a lot more money. I decided to give these a try to see if they would be close enough to switch. The answer is YES! I love that there is an exfoliating side and a soft side., it makes my daily routine so simple! These pads hold up through a full face treatment and after that, I swipe them on the bottom of my feet so they stay extra soft. The scent isn't discernable at all (WIIN!) so these wipes are a total winner!

I love the entire design of this product! From the flip top to the included tweezers to keep the pads sanitary and fresh. The skin feel is out of this world immediately makes your skin smoother/softer while getting rid of any flaking or peeling you may have. Great for people with normal or sensitive skin as the pads have little to no fragrance, I've had zero issues with redness or any kind of purging. Overall, the pads are a great quality that's super effective for addressing a variety of skin concerns.

$10 for a tub of these pads isn't too crazy good price as this will last me 2 months I think it's cute it came with a set of tongs to grab each pad when i first swiped, i didn't feel anything this stuff doesn't smell or have an instant burning sensation like the ones i use so i thought it didn't do anything BUT - if you give it about 10 minutes - i felt my skin seemed "cleaner" like there wasn't anything on my face and it dried it and cleared it up and left me with a clean feeling interesting that it took a few minutes

Ok WOW! Super pore tightening!!! I apply after washing my face and I LOVE how gentle but effective this product is. Smell is unscented and I noticed how good my skin felt after. Not pulling tight, but each pore was closed tight. Face felt moisturized and clean. Dry skin is gone and I am not over producing oil after use. Love this and recommend it! Price is right!

For me, these glycolic acid pads feel really convenient for daily skincare. The double-sided texture is easy to use—the rough side gently exfoliates without irritation, and the smooth side leaves my skin feeling hydrated and refreshed. I’ve noticed my pores look cleaner and my skin feels less oily after using them, and the combination of tea tree and centella asiatica makes it soothing for sensitive areas. It’s a simple addition to my routine that keeps my face looking balanced and healthy.

These were more soothing and refreshing than I expected them to be. They feel cool and fresh on my face. I targeted the enlarged pores around my nose and cheeks. Time will tell if I see a reduction in the size of my pores in these areas. In the meantime, I find it a pleasant addition to my daily skin care routine. The enclosed plastic tweezers help keep the jar clean and germ free. That’s a nice touch.

avis.titre: Love that they contain tea tree oil
avis.texte: These are pretty good glycolic acid pads. I like that they also contain things like niacinamide, salicylic acid and tea tree oil. The pads are well soaked, but are on the smaller side. However, for the current price of $9.99 you do get 60 pads, which is a pretty good value. Even if you end up using 2 a day, that is still a 30 day supply.
